# `aitbc system show`

Show systemd properties for a service.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc system show [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--service` | text | — | yes | Service to show properties for |
| `--properties` | text | — | no | Comma-separated list of systemd properties |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc system show --service <service>
```
